// CASE ts_worker_results_typed expect=pass
export async function mapLimit<T, R>(items: readonly T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]> {
  let next = 0;
  const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
  return results;
}
// CASE ts_worker_void_typed expect=pass
export async function mapLimit<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
}
// CASE ts_chunk_void_typed expect=pass
export async function mapLimit<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  for (let offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    await Promise.all(items.slice(offset, offset + width).map(operation));
  }
}
// CASE ts_inorder_typed_void_reason expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
// CASE ts_steps_typed expect=pass
export async function inOrderSteps(steps: ReadonlyArray<() => Promise<void>>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  void reason;
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
}
// CASE ts_inorder_call_with_reason expect=pass
export async function migrate(rows: string[], save: (row: string) => Promise<void>) {
  await inOrder(rows, save, { reason: "Each update reads the row the previous step wrote" });
}
